name: Nimbus the Weather-watcher
conversations: Today's forecast: still. Tomorrow's forecast: still. I've started forecasting in pencil, to save ink.
See that cliff to the north? Every breeze on Leafwind used to come pouring off it, like water off a roof.
Now there's something knotted up there. Wind, tangled in itself. I've watched it for weeks. It doesn't move.
My weathervane used to spin so fast the children called it the Dizzy Rooster.
Now it points north. Always north. As if it's trying to tell me something.
The calm started the same week the Great Tree's leaves went grey. I wrote it down.
I write everything down. It doesn't help, but it's tidy.
